title: Ankhorage Renovate
summary: Publishes the canonical Renovate dependency-update presets and synchronization workflow used by Ankhorage repositories.
purpose: Centralize dependency-update ownership, grouping, safety exceptions, and rollout behavior so standalone repositories receive consistent automated updates.
responsibilities: Publish the shared Renovate preset and the Devtools-owner specialization.
Group and automerge validated npm and Ankhorage package updates while reserving owner-managed runtime and platform upgrades.
Synchronize the immutable Renovate workflow and validate selected-repository GitHub App coverage.
boundaries: Does not implement package-manager installation, project migration, or release publishing.
Does not grant the Renovate GitHub App access to repositories; organization owners manage the selected-repository installation.
Does not own Bun, Expo, React Native, or Devtools policy values that are managed by their canonical owner repositories.
audience: Automation that distributes and validates the canonical Renovate configuration.
useCases: Apply the shared dependency-update policy to an Ankhorage repository.
Use the Devtools-owner preset for dependencies validated by the Devtools repository.
Propagate a reviewed immutable Renovate workflow revision across selected repositories.

architecture.role: A configuration and automation repository that publishes Renovate presets and a reusable synchronization workflow.
invariants: Dependency families are enabled by explicit ownership rules after the default-deny package rule.
Owner-managed runtime and platform versions are not updated through competing consumer rules.
Repository synchronization is limited to repositories explicitly accessible to the GitHub App installation.

configuration: The ankhorage-renovate-sync GitHub App installation must explicitly include every managed repository.
limitations: Renovate applies only the managers and dependency families enabled by the published presets.
